presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own F-Zero (USA) .sfc file without a copier header. Portcove installs the Windows port and manages its saves and settings separately from existing external copies. This package enables BS Deluxe changes by default. Other mods, MSU music, developer tracing and capture setups are outside this reviewed route. Windows gameplay remains untested. This Windows build needs a short installation folder using basic Latin characters; original game files can stay in their existing location.

decisions.rationale: The former path returns HTTP 301 to numeric repository ID 1348026644, which is the repository identity the reviewed v1.8.3 release pin already binds, and the current RetroPortingToolKit path resolves to that same identity. The reviewed release 393440319 and Windows asset 580473673 keep their identities, size and SHA-256 at the new path. Every commit reachable from the repository's published branches and tags records the same author email, including the v1.8.3 release commit and the earliest recorded merge from a RetroPortingToolKit branch on 2026-10-30.

Observer relocation candidates recorded the former path's HTTP 301 to repository ID 1348026644 and the current name without following the redirect.

Merge of pull request #18, the earliest recorded merge from a RetroPortingToolKit branch, records the same author email as all earlier history, including v1.8.3 at 1686df46d4fc7c22b5dc8fdfaa5282ca4bd78562.
A later release, v0.14.1, publishes a differently named F-Zero Forever product line whose assets do not match the reviewed selector; this relocation does not review or adopt that line.

decisions.reconsider_when: Reassess if either path resolves to a different provider identity, the reviewed v1.8.3 release or asset identity changes, or attributable contradictory continuity evidence appears.
